name: 50k Lead Generation System
headline: 50k Lead Generation System for B2B Sales
short_description: The 50k-lead-generation-system is a strong B2B lead generation tool that integrates Apollo.io, Google Search, and LinkedIn scraping with AI qualification. It automates the generation, enrichment, and scoring of thousands of leads, streamlining your sales process.
author: Awaisali36

sections.overview:
The 50k Lead Generation System is a complete B2B lead generation automation that combines Apollo.io scraping, Google Search, and LinkedIn profile enrichment into a single workflow. It generates thousands of qualified leads automatically by extracting prospect data from multiple sources, enriching each profile with 25+ fields including emails, mobile numbers, and work history, then scoring lead quality using Google Gemini AI against your custom Ideal Customer Profile. The system uses n8n automation and Airtable to organize leads by campaign with intelligent status tracking. It solves the manual prospecting problem by processing what would take days of research in hours, enabling sales teams, marketing agencies, SDR teams, and growth-focused startups to scale B2B prospecting from dozens to thousands of leads with consistent quality and AI-powered scoring.
Automating lead generation for B2B sales teams
Enriching lead data for better targeting
Scoring leads based on AI-driven insights
Integrating multiple data sources for comprehensive prospecting
sections.usage:
```
Generate a list of 50,000 qualified leads for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Use Apollo.io, Google Search, and LinkedIn scraping to gather data. Enrich and score each lead based on factors like company size, revenue, and decision-maker roles. Prioritize leads with high potential for conversion.
```
